title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: partnership contract term and dues price protection by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's employer partnership contract term, whether the partnership is reviewed annually, and the protection against a per-employee rate increase during the contract.

| Tier | Contract term | Annual partnership review required | Employer's notice to end the partnership early | Months the per-employee rate is locked | Notice required before a rate increase takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | 12 months | No | 30 calendar days | 12 months | 30 calendar days |
| Small Business Partner | 12 months | Yes | 30 calendar days | 12 months | 30 calendar days |
| Mid-Market Partner | 24 months | Yes | 45 calendar days | 24 months | 45 calendar days |
| Enterprise Partner | 36 months | Yes | 60 calendar days | 36 months | 60 calendar days |
| Municipal Partner | 12 months | Yes | 60 calendar days | 12 months | 60 calendar days |
| Nonprofit Partner | 12 months | Yes | 45 calendar days | 12 months | 45 calendar days |

The employer's notice period to end the partnership early is measured in calendar days given ahead of the intended end date; the rate-lock period runs for that same number of months from the start of the contract term, and any per-employee rate increase after that period requires the tier's own advance notice before it takes effect.
